authority: #K2-469 appendix B (bound to the #K2-468 window, fail-closed): every parameter of the escape planner must cite REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.E; anything uncited must be named "maintain current value" with a one-time reason (sec.20.5). The extension shipped as R1506; this is its citation ledger.

dirs_8_incl_45deg.citation: REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.E: industry fanout/escape passes (KiCad fanout, FreeRouting, commercial tools) route pin escapes at 45 degrees, not only orthogonally; the book puts the 45-degree practice in the same entry that names the in-repo mechanism anchors.

dogleg_two_segments.value: two segments: seg1 <= 5 steps (<=0.5mm), turn +/-45 deg, seg2 <= 5 steps (<=0.5mm)
dogleg_two_segments.citation: REF-CASE-LIBRARY sec.E: the same industry practice - dense fields are escaped with a dogleg/offset rather than one straight leg; the limits are kept deliberately SHORT (0.5mm each) so the corridor stays inside the pad neighbourhood, which is what a fanout/escape pass does.
dogleg_two_segments.one_time_note: the exact split (5/5) is a first implementation choice with no product citation for the split itself; it is declared here rather than presented as product-derived. It is conservative (shorter legs = less freedom consumed) and bounded.

max_escape_len_2p0mm.citation: NONE - inherited from the supervisor prescription (#K2-467 sec.2.1).
max_escape_len_2p0mm.one_time_reason: MAINTAIN CURRENT VALUE: it was the commissioning parameter and it has not been shown to be the binding cause (the census shows the refusals come from obstacles within ~1mm, not from the 2.0mm cut-off). Changing it before the scheme-layer decision would be ad-hoc tuning (sec.20.5).
max_escape_len_2p0mm.supervisor_self_correction: M-SUP-PRESCRIPTION-UNGROUNDED +1 (the value was prescribed without product grounding).

step_0p1mm.citation: NONE - inherited from the same prescription.
step_0p1mm.one_time_reason: MAINTAIN CURRENT VALUE: consistent with the maze fine step (FINE_STEP=0.10) already in the register, so it is at least coherent with the engine; changing it is a relaxation nobody asked for.

clear_0p30mm.citation: PARTIAL: the chain acceptance caliber is floor 0.20 (wrapper --floor) plus the 0.10 trace half-width, i.e. 0.30 is DERIVED from the registered acceptance model rather than invented - see the R1434-era notes on the caliber divergence (M-ENG-CLEARANCE-MODEL-DIVERGENCE).
clear_0p30mm.one_time_reason: MAINTAIN CURRENT VALUE: it equals acceptance floor + own half-width, which is the strictest coherent reading of the register.

local_filter_radius_3p5mm.citation: NONE - implementation detail (a performance bound, not a geometry rule).
local_filter_radius_3p5mm.one_time_reason: MAINTAIN CURRENT VALUE: it is >= max_escape_len + dogleg reach, so it cannot change any decision; it exists only to honour the owner red line (no CPU spike).

verdict_ge_the_unconnected_ends_only.value: escape assets are required for UNCONNECTED endpoints only; connected ends PASS-by-route
verdict_ge_the_unconnected_ends_only.citation: #K2-468 sec.3.2 (the gate-scope self-correction) + the in-repo arithmetic: C1=2 has been stable for many windows with the same two named residuals, and the census matched 2 refusals to those 2 ends exactly.

status_pending: appendix A (the FAIL branch -> scheme-layer dead-exit/relocation drawing per sec.16.3) is NOT produced yet; the precheck reading (go=FALSE, two named refusals) is the input it needs. Declared, not pretended.
